notes.title: Quick fix for losing upgrades
notes.notes:
With this update your previous upgrades will be refunded to you so you can purchase them again. Players were upset losing their upgrades (rightfully so), so hopefully this makes it right.

This patch scans for a file named "save0.05.txt" in the Dragon Kings_Data folder. It looks for all upgrades and weapon unlocks and returns the coins. 

Thank you all for suggestions, ideas, and patience!

Support is generally quicker in our discord. Feel free to stop in, say hi and share ideas.

notes.title: Achievement Fix Update and other fixes
notes.notes:
Warning please read!

This update modifies the way the game is saved. By updating you will be required to start over.
Instead of one large file. Data is now saved individually per category:

SaveVersion, WeaponVersion, PlayerStatsVersion, StatsVersion, SettingsVersion, UpgradesVersion, AchievementsVersion, ElementsVersion, LevelsVersion

Unfortunately, this requires the player to start all over.  In the long term it will be beneficial as any corrupted file won't cause you to lose the whole save block. And it should be easier to modify a small save category instead of a whole save block.

You can find this data named appropriately in the folder ""Dragon Kings_Data"" .  However, this data is not modifiable because it is serialized to save space. To modify this data it needs to be deserialized, then it can be modded, and then reserialized to save. I can adjust this upon popular request.

Additional fixes:

Fixed escape button quit game
Doubled coin spawn rate
Doubled health spawns
Fixed base achievements. More to come as requested! 

Thank you everyone for the support!
